svg.title: FIG-01 supplement: current runtime access
svg.desc: External product project; Application: resources, scheduling, execution progress; Nexus reusable platform; Typed factory: lookup of existing instances; Public face: readonly ops + context; Optional owner / execution adapter; Optional OS / wait-wake; SoC provider: private instance state; Core: request, deadline, epoch; Arch: compile-time CPU primitives; Selected controller / IRQ / DMA; Obtain interface; Return existing reference; Direct I/O after successful start; Optional shared path; Executor port uses interface; Explicit task and wait selection; Selected wait / wake adaptation; Lifecycle and stable slots; Request and time contracts; Direct CPU primitive call; ops(context, ...); Drive selected hardware mode
